implementation: Preserve the effective previous holdouts and exclusions when merging new text.
Reuse verified old token spans and encode new text; keep active phase inputs immutable.
Decode and encode real video frames for Kimi, Qwen and MF1.
Dispatch successor phases on file and process events using exact parent and input identities.
Observe continuous same-attention main-phase performance during formal updates; retain parent, data and transition checks.
Keep the offline quickstart compatible with records that do not use incremental encoding identifiers.

cpu_regression.command: CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES='' OMP_NUM_THREADS=2 MKL_NUM_THREADS=2 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=2 python -m pytest -q -m 'not cuda'

validation.offline_regression: Found in the first full run and fixed in baeffd7; the subsequent full suite passed.

real_video_encoding.scope: CPU data-path checks; not a training or capability result.

text.token_scope: Reference-token counts are not final native or MF1 training CE counts.

natural_images.scope: Partial top-up; reuse existing image and OCR inventories before further downloads.

media.repetition_plan_correction: Two passes were the K1/Q1 execution settings, not a frozen K2/Q2 pretraining cap. Compare per-domain independent QA inventory and cumulative media exposures before selecting subsequent phase epochs; the SFT two-epoch rule does not apply here.

limits_note: These are write limits, not measured usage. Existing active inputs remain retained. Transfers use direct connections; no GPU work is scheduled on the storage host.

followup.scope: Data preparation and recipe decisions after the initial snapshot. The source and CPU regression results above remain bound to their original release; no new source commit or GPU result is asserted here.

text.scope: Same corpus with different tokenizers; CE totals are not independent supply and must not be added.

natural.existing_topup_native: optional_not_required_before_next_phase; no additional old raw transfer scheduled

video.target_policy: Bounded supply target; readiness uses actual CE and exposures, not an obligation to reach the candidate count.

multipage.selection: Exactly two pages from the same source document and one complete question/answer; no page or answer truncation.
multipage.next: Incremental identities, conservative new-group exclusions, native Kimi/Qwen encoding and assembly.
multipage.scope: Multipage document QA. Web paragraph/image interleaving is a separate later data task, not a new prerequisite for starting K2/Q2.

image_mixture_proposal.reason: Each complete multipage QA contains two images. Chart supply has many questions per image, so weighting unique images avoids excessive chart exposure. These are project choices, not published upstream percentages.
image_mixture_proposal.epoch_scope: Per-domain QA rows; not a maximum on repeated appearances of one image. No two/five-pass pretraining rule is inferred from SFT.

mf1_p1.curriculum: Reuse existing 49-feature components and encode new natural images with 100 features; record actual resolution and CE shares.
mf1_p1.video_timing: Prepare in parallel with P0; select from measured P1 video CE and exposure supply.

chart_exposure_adjustment.scope: Per-image average for planned P1, not a proven optimal recipe; P0 exposures are additional.

ordinary_validation_reused.scope: Existing periodic validation observation. The final P0 checkpoint still binds its own phase-end metrics; these gaps are not a capability qualification or a new experiment.

execution.validation: Relevant minimal CPU checks for changed paths; normal formal-training observation. Separate GPU smoke is not a default phase prerequisite; reproduce concrete failures briefly when necessary.
execution.task_management: File/process events and waitpid; failures stop the affected component with a recorded cause.
execution.transfers: Direct only; storage host supplies files and performs no training.
execution.kimi_handoff: A running event publisher waits only for Kimi new-natural completion and the Kimi multipage component; it assembles the actual data, derives the phase recipe and publishes the parent-bound K2 command without waiting for Qwen/MF1.

encoding_reservations.scope: Bounded concurrent data tasks; no additional encoder starts outside this reservation.

source_release.scope: Video continuation, complete multipage source, text-origin exclusions and declared source holdout threshold; model computation unchanged.

validation.scope: Targeted CPU checks for changed data and admission paths; the historical full regression above is not a new full-suite claim.
